name: CSV to Firestore
description: Reads a CSV file from Cloud Storage and upserts each row as a document in a Firestore collection.

parameters.name: input
parameters.label: Input CSV file
parameters.helpText: Cloud Storage path of the CSV file with a header row, e.g. gs://my-bucket/input/employees.csv

parameters.name: collection
parameters.label: Firestore collection
parameters.helpText: Name of the Firestore collection to write documents into, e.g. employees

parameters.name: keyField
parameters.label: Document ID column
parameters.helpText: CSV column whose value becomes the Firestore document ID. Defaults to id.

parameters.name: firestoreProject
parameters.label: Firestore project
parameters.helpText: Project that hosts Firestore. Defaults to the Dataflow job project.
